verdict.rationale: The CLI evidence implies a human-in-the-loop gate: an 'auto-approve all actions' option suggests actions need approval by default [openhands-docs-3], and Esc pauses the running agent [openhands-docs-17]. That is per-action approval, not review of a consolidated diff before a PR. Other evidence shows automations opening pull requests on their own [openhands-docs-9, openhands-docs-10] and only generic 'Git integrations' [openhands-docs-26]. Missing for 10: a documented diff view of the agent's changes, an explicit approve-before-PR workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
